(2) A 'Pop' sound effect triggers a transition. A second male voice speaks energetically in Japanese, enunciating the word 'Kaeru' with high pitch and excitement. The background music continues with a steady rhythm. (3) Subsequent 'Pop' SFX transitions occur every few seconds as three distinct male voices take turns saying 'Kaeru' with varying intonations—some questioning, some assertive, and some joyful. The vocal interplay is rapid and rhythmic. (4) Laughter is heard briefly between speech segments. The music maintains a constant volume bed beneath the voices. (5) The video concludes with a collective vocalization of the word, followed by a quick musical fade-out and a final comedic 'ding' or soft impact sound.
